cases.intent: Explain how BTC enters Mezo and connects borrowing, products, voting and MEZO emissions; assess whether SDK boundaries describe the whole economy.
requiredOutcomes: Start from BTC custody and borrowing, then connect product revenue, veBTC, complementary veMEZO boosts, voting and a single partitioned MEZO emission budget.
Distinguish Threshold/tBTC custody, Ethereum bridge custody and native BTC on Mezo; explain Bitcoin and Ethereum entry from the sourced map.
Keep separate veMEZO external-gauge voting and deployed rebase evidence; the whitepaper is design authority, not proof of a deployed formula.
Describe the wider asset/bridge picture while explicitly identifying missing indexed qualification and SDK coverage.
prohibitedOutcomes: Use package inventory or MUSD-versus-mUSDC terminology as the organizing model for the whole economy.
Infer that MEZO shares every MUSD NTT destination, or that both assets support BSC because the bridge UI does.
Treat unsupported routes as nonexistent Mezo features, or published design as current execution readiness.
Require a wallet, live transaction simulation or every module maintenance validator for a conceptual explanation.

cases.intent: Explain why Savings receipts, a gauge position and classic MUSD trove collateral are different without preparing any transaction.
requiredOutcomes: Explain 1:1 Savings principal separately from indexed yield, gauge custody, redirected voter revenue and MEZO rewards.
Keep Savings outside classic trove, TCR, Stability Pool and redemption accounting.
Use scoped records for the explanation and reserve live-state, simulation and maintenance checks for the operations that require them.
prohibitedOutcomes: Count gauge-held receipts again as wallet principal or count redirected yield as direct interest as well.
Block an explanation solely because a writer has no supported release.
Fetch current balances or simulate a deposit that the user did not request.
